summary: Iteration 11 - Dashboard redesign (Tactical Center) frontend testing complete. Login as superadmin, sidebar (260↔72 collapse with localStorage persist), topbar, profile dropdown, welcome banner, 8 KPI cards, 2 recharts, mobile drawer, page transitions, tactical-sniper-untouched, logout — all PASS. One minor bug found: topbar page title incorrectly stays 'Admin' for /admin/users and /admin/packages because nav item /app/admin lacks `end:true` causing pathname.startsWith() to match before more specific sub-paths. No console errors. Did not test UserOverview / MarketingDashboard live (no non-superadmin seeded user available; tested via code inspection only).

ui_bugs.issue: topbar-title shows 'Admin' when navigating to /app/admin/users (expected 'Users') and /app/admin/packages (expected 'Packages'). Root cause: in DashboardLayout.js line 45, the activeItem find() uses `loc.pathname.startsWith(it.to)` for any item without `end:true`. The Admin entry (/app/admin) appears at index 2 in ALL_NAV BEFORE Users (index 3) and Packages (index 4), so /app/admin matches first for any /app/admin/* sub-route. Fix: change the matching to prefer the longest/most-specific match (e.g. sort items by `to.length` desc before `find`, or change Admin's `to` to have `end:true` and accept that Admin tab won't stay highlighted on sub-pages — but for sidebar active highlighting we want startsWith; only fix the title computation by re-finding the most-specific match).

action_items: Fix topbar-title computation in /app/frontend/src/components/DashboardLayout.js line 45: when on /app/admin/users etc, activeItem currently returns the Admin entry. Suggested fix: `const activeItem = [...items].sort((a,b)=>b.to.length-a.to.length).find((it)=> it.end ? loc.pathname === it.to : (loc.pathname === it.to || loc.pathname.startsWith(it.to + '/'))) || items[0];`

(Optional) Seed a non-superadmin user (role=user with package and trial clicks) and a marketing user so future iterations can verify UserOverview and MarketingDashboard pages live. Currently only superadmin exists per /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
(Optional) Cleanup duplicate TEST_Premium Package entries in MongoDB (carry-over from iteration 10).
critical_code_review_comments: DashboardLayout.js line 220: `paddingLeft: typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.innerWidth >= 1024 ? sidebarWidth + 32 : 16` — this only evaluates at render time, not on resize. If user resizes from desktop→mobile or vice versa without navigation, topbar paddingLeft and main marginLeft will be stale until re-render. Acceptable trade-off but consider a resize listener for production.
DashboardLayout.js line 45 active-item logic doesn't handle prefix collision (cause of the topbar-title bug above).

WelcomeBanner.js uses <a href={a.to}> for navigation actions instead of react-router Link — this triggers a full page reload (loses SPA state) when 'Kelola Users'/'Transaksi' buttons are clicked. Recommend switching to Link or useNavigate.
All 8 KPI testids, charts, transitions, drawer, collapse, profile dropdown, logout flow are well-implemented with proper data-testids.

rca_of_the_issue: topbar-title bug: in DashboardLayout.js line 45, `items.find((it) => (it.end ? loc.pathname === it.to : loc.pathname.startsWith(it.to)))` returns the FIRST item whose to is a prefix of current path. Since Admin entry (/app/admin) precedes Users (/app/admin/users) and Packages (/app/admin/packages) in ALL_NAV array, and /app/admin is a prefix of both, find() returns Admin. Reproduce: login as superadmin → click nav-users → observe topbar-title text reads 'Admin' instead of 'Users'. Fix: sort candidates by `to.length` descending before find(), and ensure exact-or-segment-boundary match (compare `loc.pathname === it.to || loc.pathname.startsWith(it.to + '/')`) to avoid false prefix matches like /app vs /app/admin.
